remarks: Welcome to 24 Harold Street, where style, space, and convenience come together in the heart of Cos Cob. Enjoy easy access to parks, coffee shops, restaurants, the waterfront, Metro-North, and I-95, with Greenwich Avenue less than five minutes away and NYC under an hour. Step inside to a beautifully designed home featuring a chef's kitchen with stainless steel appliances and an oversized island. A first-floor bedroom with a full bathroom offers exceptional flexibility for guests, a home office, or convenient main-level living, with easy access to the garage. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a soaking tub, walk-in closet, and custom California Closets. Front and rear decks offer ideal spots for morning coffee, fresh air, or tending to a herb garden. Outside, the gated and fenced front yard provides added privacy along with plenty of space to enjoy the outdoors. The generous rear yard is perfect for kicking a ball around, relaxing with friends, or hosting the next neighborhood get-together. The finished lower level adds even more flexible living space and can easily serve as a gym, playroom, home office, or media room. With beautiful curb appeal, versatile living spaces, and an unbeatable location, 24 Harold Street truly has it all.
